children.title: Cycle 19 · Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity and Mechanical Constraints

detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity and Mechanical Constraints
detail.summary: This cycle advances the investigation into accountable cross-turn state continuity for autonomous AI agents. Building on newly integrated evidence regarding heterogeneous memory maintenance and hardware-software constraints, we examine how mechanical architectures address gaps in AI agent identity lifecycle management.
